hops.rationale: Within GS 2026 scope (accession 000088698226000091), the passages give the core regulatory capital ratio disclosures. Passage 178 lists the consolidated risk-based minimums and total requirements (CET1 10.9%/13.7%, Tier 1 12.4%/15.2%, Total 14.4%/17.2% for Standardized, plus Advanced figures) and the leverage requirements. Passage 180 gives consolidated Standardized CET1 15.0% (2025) vs 15.3% (2024), Tier 1 16.8% vs 17.1%, Total 18.8% vs 18.6%, and the Tier 1 leverage 6.6% vs 6.8% and SLR 5.2% vs 5.5%. Passages 182, 89 and 92 add GS Bank USA, GSBE and GSI ratios. The consolidated Advanced CET1, Tier 1 and Total ratio values are referenced in the text but not clearly shown as numbers, so that is the only gap. Nothing required in this scope is entirely absent.

Verified filing excerpts (extractive audit evidence; no derived calculations):

- The firm calculates its CET1 capital, Tier 1 capital and Total capital ratios in accordance with both the Standardized and Advanced Capital Rules. [GS-2026-10K-item8-p000178](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886982/000088698226000091/gs-20251231.htm) (chunk: `000088698226000091#item8#passage-000178`; accession: `0000886982-26-000091`).
- Under the Capital Framework, the firm is also subject to leverage requirements which consist of a minimum Tier 1 leverage ratio and a minimum supplementary leverage ratio \(SLR\), as well as the SLR buffer. [GS-2026-10K-item8-p000178](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886982/000088698226000091/gs-20251231.htm) (chunk: `000088698226000091#item8#passage-000178`; accession: `0000886982-26-000091`).
- The lower of each risk-based capital ratio under the Standardized and Advanced Capital Rules is the ratio against which GS Bank USA’s compliance with its risk-based capital requirements is assessed. [GS-2026-10K-item8-p000182](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886982/000088698226000091/gs-20251231.htm) (chunk: `000088698226000091#item8#passage-000182`; accession: `0000886982-26-000091`).
- In the table above, the Standardized risk-based capital ratios as of December 2025 decreased compared with December 2024, reflecting an increase in Credit RWAs, partially offset by a decrease in Market RWAs and an increase in capital. [GS-2026-10K-item8-p000180](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886982/000088698226000091/gs-20251231.htm) (chunk: `000088698226000091#item8#passage-000180`; accession: `0000886982-26-000091`).
- On January 1, 2026, the firm early adopted the modified Enhanced Supplementary Leverage Ratio \(eSLR\) standards, which replaced the 2% buffer applicable to G-SIBs, with a buffer equal to 50% of the firm's G-SIB surcharge \(Method 1\). [GS-2026-10K-item8-p000180](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/886982/000088698226000091/gs-20251231.htm) (chunk: `000088698226000091#item8#passage-000180`; accession: `0000886982-26-000091`).
